subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this proof stack require a successful Telegram Desktop baseline/candidate run before it is used to decide the split generated-media wake-false PRs?
rationale: The PR exists specifically to produce live-visible proof, but the only linked run skipped both lanes; only maintainers can decide whether to require rerun proof, accept scheduler-level proof, or stop using this temporary stack.

options.title: Require Working Telegram Proof
options.body: Keep this draft as non-landing proof infrastructure until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, live output, or logs show baseline missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Accept Scheduler-Level Proof
options.body: Maintainers can decide the mocked scheduler coverage is enough for the internal failure mode and proceed with the split PRs without a successful Telegram Desktop artifact.

options.title: Close The Stack
options.body: If the proof runner cannot exercise this scenario, close this temporary draft and continue review on the separate implementation and harness PRs.

recommendation.title: Require Working Telegram Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this draft as non-landing proof infrastructure until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, live output, or logs show baseline missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision centers on the Telegram/Mantis proof runner path, where Vincent Koc has recent relevant history.
